verdict.rationale: Exa documents an official, open-source MCP server with a complete setup guide for connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex, and any other MCP client to its web search, fetching, Exa Agent, and Exa Connect tools, and no API key is required to start. A probe independently confirms the documented MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
